elements.title: Accent Words + Eyebrow
elements.desc: Headline words rise with a spring stagger, accent words coloured, mono eyebrow above
elements.use: editorial hooks with 1-2 emphasised words

elements.title: Age Numeral Roll
elements.desc: Big serif numeral that rolls over on each cut (old rises and blurs out, new rises in), unit label below, last value italic accent. Use for ages, scores, years, counters tied to cuts.
elements.use: a value changes at every cut (age, year, level, rank)

elements.title: App Icon Launcher
elements.desc: 3x3 grid of generic rounded app tiles that pop in in a seeded random order (back-out scale + untwist), float, then one tile is tapped with a ring pulse while the rest dim. Use for "all your tools in one place" and launch/feature-grid beats.
elements.use: feature/tool roundups, "everything in one place", app-launch hooks.

elements.title: Article Highlight
elements.desc: Editorial paper card (section label, serif headline, byline, body) that blurs into focus, then a physical marker sweeps key phrases left to right behind the text in sequence, ending on a gentle zoom. Use for news/release/proof beats where the quote is the evidence.
elements.use: "as reported by", launch/trend proof, quoting a sentence that matters.

elements.title: Assemble Then Type Flyin
elements.desc: A page builds itself on an empty dark grid. Eleven textless skeleton pieces fly in and snap on first; then every word and character tumbles in from 3D space, headline first and tiny labels last. Use for a poster or page assembling itself, or a layout-tool feature reveal.
elements.use: a page or poster "growing itself" as an opener; design or layout product showcases; a two-step story of skeleton first, content second.

elements.title: Atom Orbit 3D
elements.desc: Atom model: a nucleus of clustered spheres, three tilted orbit rings and electrons that travel their orbits while the whole atom slowly turns.
elements.use: science/tech/AI explainers, "atomic" metaphors.

elements.title: Burst In
elements.desc: Animated text — one word at a time pops 0→100% with 115% overshoot while 14 accent rays shoot outward.
elements.use: title/hook words, impact reveals.

elements.title: Char Slam
elements.desc: Animated text — letters slam in one at a time (240% to 100%, ±7° tilt alternating) and STAY in place, spelling out the whole word before the loop restarts.
elements.use: punchy word build-ups, trailers, title reveals (a short word spelled letter by letter).

elements.title: Stamp
elements.desc: Animated text — three bordered rounded stamps, tilted -9°/5°/-4°, slam down one by one then fade together.
elements.use: approval / status labels, badges.

elements.title: Zoom At Camera
elements.desc: Animated text — word rushes from 6% to 100% (exponential ease-out) trailing three accent ghost layers, then blasts past camera.
elements.use: hero word reveals, shock titles.

elements.title: Stacked Slide
elements.desc: Animated text — three stacked lines slide in alternately from left/right with 18° skew that straightens; previous lines dim to 45%.
elements.use: multi-line slogans, teasers.

elements.title: Stretch Wave
elements.desc: Animated text — each character, anchored at its bottom, stretches to 200% height / 78% width and springs back in a travelling wave.
elements.use: playful titles, growth / height themes.

elements.title: Fly Through
elements.desc: Animated text — word holds then accelerates to 17× past the camera while the next word grows from 35% behind it.
elements.use: scene-to-scene word chains, tunnel feel.

elements.title: Drop Bounce
elements.desc: Animated text — accent word falls from above, squashes to 50% height, bounces ~20% frame height, re-lands lightly, settles, then crouches and launches out.
elements.use: landing/impact words, playful titles.

elements.title: Animated Text 09 · Giant Traverse
elements.desc: Giant words (800px) glide right-to-left at constant speed while a thin accent band at the bottom carries the same string in small type, left-to-right and faster. Seamless.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 10 · Row Counterflow (horizontal)
elements.desc: Five horizontal rows fill the safe height; rows 1/3/5 scroll left in main colour, 2/4 scroll right in accent colour, each with a slightly different speed.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 11 · Repeat Wave
elements.desc: One word tiled over the frame at 10% opacity; a diagonal brightness wave sweeps top-left to bottom-right every 2 s, peak words turn accent.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 12 · Slant Bands
elements.desc: Two adjacent ribbons tilted 9 deg counter-clockwise: accent+sans runs right-to-left, main-colour+serif (bg-coloured text) runs left-to-right.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 13 · Curve Run
elements.desc: Wide accent ribbon on an S-curve from bottom-left to top-right; words joined by • flow along it at constant speed, every glyph rotated to the curve tangent.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 15 · Depth Rows (horizontal)
elements.desc: Seven centred horizontal rows faking depth: centre largest in accent, flanks medium 55%, outer four small 28%; neighbours run opposite directions at different speeds.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Animated Text 16 · Cross Tape
elements.desc: Two tapes cross in an X: accent +12 deg clockwise, main colour -10 deg counter-clockwise with bg-coloured text; text runs in opposite directions at constant speed.
elements.use: kinetic-typography backgrounds / title cards needing endless seamless flow motion.

elements.title: Flip Board
elements.desc: Station-style split-flap tiles that flicker random chars at 11/s then settle left-to-right on each word.
elements.use: short announcement words (up to ~8 chars), transit/news tickers

elements.title: Flip Card
elements.desc: White cards rotate 180 degrees around the Y axis in a left-to-right wave, swapping to the next word at the edge-on moment.
elements.use: title swaps, season/episode names

elements.title: Slot Machine
elements.desc: Dark reels spin downward at once and decelerate, stopping left-to-right on the word, then flash in the accent colour.
elements.use: lucky/result reveals, short (4-6 letter) words

elements.title: Headline Rotate
elements.desc: Fixed outlined tag beside an accent window where headline words slide up out and the next slides in from below.
elements.use: news flash / rotating status headlines

elements.title: Dot Matrix Ticker
elements.desc: Full-frame LED dot grid; the text is lit accent dots stepping one dot per move from right to left.
elements.use: station/LED ticker feel, one line of text

elements.title: Split Open
elements.desc: Word splits along its horizontal midline; halves fly up-left and down-right while the next word scales 70% to 100% and fades in behind.
elements.use: start/end style swaps, one-word big titles (3-5 letters)

elements.title: Jitter Shake
elements.desc: Each glyph independently jumps to a new random offset and small rotation 24 times a second (stepped, no tween); 1.5 s violent, decays over 0.4 s to a faint tremor, then the next word starts violent.
elements.use: shock / disbelief reactions, comedic emphasis.

elements.title: Neon Tube
elements.desc: Outline-only neon tube with accent glow: starts dark (dim outline), each glyph flicker-ignites at its own time, steady glow, one random glyph blinks, then switches off left to right.
elements.use: night/bar/open-late signage, retro titles.

elements.title: Wave Bob
elements.desc: One centred row; each glyph bobs on a sine wave travelling from the first to the last glyph while tilting 6deg with the wave; 1.6 s cycle, 4.4 s per word.
elements.use: playful/relaxed phrases, loading, "swaying" words.

elements.title: Tracking Expand
elements.desc: Cinematic title: serif text fades in while letter-spacing opens linearly from 0 to 0.7em over 3.6 s, last 0.5 s fades out.
elements.use: film titles, chapter cards, slow reveals.

elements.title: Outline Fill
elements.desc: Hollow outlined glyphs; accent liquid rises from the bottom in 1.6 s (inOutCubic), holds 0.7 s, drains top-down in 0.5 s.
elements.use: charging / progress / "full" words, loading states.

elements.title: Focus Pull
elements.desc: Word starts heavily blurred, 115 % and transparent, pulls into sharp 100 % in 1.1 s, holds 1.3 s, blurs out over 0.5 s.
elements.use: reveal / realisation / "it clicks" moments.

elements.title: Prism Flip
elements.desc: Word sits on an accent bar that rolls up 90 deg like a 4-sided prism; next word turns in from the underside.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Perspective Crawl
elements.desc: Centered lines on a plane tilted back 56 deg crawl away at constant speed and fade into the bg.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Orbit Ring Text
elements.desc: Accent centre word stays still while ring text circles it clockwise, glyph bottoms facing the centre.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Text Tunnel
elements.desc: 7 stacked copies of the word (solid/outline alternating) fly toward the camera with accelerating scale.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Scatter Gather
elements.desc: Glyphs start scattered (random pos/rot, 180%), fly home one by one, hold, then burst outward and fade.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Thick Shadow Extrude
elements.desc: 12 tight hard shadows form a solid extrusion that grows with overshoot, sweeps direction, then retracts.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Strip Assemble
elements.desc: Word cut into 6 horizontal strips: odd from the left, even from the right, staggered, leaving in reverse.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Block Reveal
elements.desc: Accent block grows over the word left to right, retracts to the right to reveal it, later covers and carries it away.
elements.use: kinetic title/lyric cards for 9:16 reels, one word per beat, seamless loop.

elements.title: Beat Stomp
elements.desc: Beat Stomp — Chars pop in on the beat with overshoot; newest char in accent
elements.use: lyric / music-video captions, 9:16 kinetic type, seamless loop.

elements.title: Downbeat Invert
elements.desc: Downbeat Invert — Per-beat colour inversion with 130%/160% scale punch
elements.use: lyric / music-video captions, 9:16 kinetic type, seamless loop.

elements.title: Soft Focus Rise
elements.desc: Soft Focus Rise — Chars float up from blur and transparency, then the line drifts away
elements.use: lyric / music-video captions, 9:16 kinetic type, seamless loop.

elements.title: Lyric Scroll
elements.desc: Lyric Scroll — Music-app lyric column: current line centred in accent, neighbours 60% / 30%
elements.use: lyric / music-video captions, 9:16 kinetic type, seamless loop.

elements.title: Beat Echo Trail
elements.desc: Beat Echo Trail — Six hollow outline echoes flung up/down on every beat
elements.use: lyric / music-video captions, 9:16 kinetic type, seamless loop.

elements.title: Size Mix Block
elements.desc: Size Mix Block — Four words packed in one rectangle, flying in from left/top/bottom/right
elements.use: lyric / music-video captions, 9:16 kinetic type, seamless loop.

elements.title: Popup Variety Card
elements.desc: One word at a time pops 0→100% in 0.7s with spring rebound + wobble, 3° tilt alternating per word, holds 1s, shrinks away. 2.2s/word.
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: Diagonal Slam Card
elements.desc: Word slams from outside top-right at 240% to centre in 0.16s, lands tilted 7° CCW; white flash + violent shake settling in 0.4s; holds 1.3s then falls out spinning. 2.2s/word.
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: Manga Focus Lines
elements.desc: Irregular radial speed lines around an elliptical clear centre, re-rolled 12x/s (seeded PRNG); centre word pops then pulses. 2.4s/word.
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: Question Exclaim Marks
elements.desc: Word pops centre, then ? (top-right), ! (top-left), ?! (right) pop 0.32s apart with overshoot, tilted and wobbling; all shrink away together. 2.6s/word.
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: Banner Strip Card
elements.desc: Accent slanted band wipes left→right in 0.3s (outCubic), whole band tilted 3° CCW; chars pop up into it 0.06s apart with overshoot; after 1.3s the band accelerates out right. 2.6s/word.
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: Keyword Zoom Card
elements.desc: Small half-size lead-in appears; 0.5s later the keyword (card style) slams 0→135%→115% while shaking sideways ~0.8s; fades out together. 2.8s/group. Prop is groups: [lead, key][].
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: Bouncing Chars Drop
elements.desc: Chars drop from above 0.1s apart, alternating two bright fills and ±6° tilt, land with a small hop; then all jump up together; shrink away. 2.6s/word (spec gives none; chosen).
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: Burst Box Card
elements.desc: 16-point spiky burst pops with overshoot, then slowly rotates/pulses; word pops slightly later, 5° CCW, high-contrast fill; holds 1.6s, shrinks together. 2.4s/word.
elements.use: variety-show style caption cards for English punchlines.

elements.title: BulbFlicker
elements.desc: Text like a dying bulb: random dim ticks at 30 grid, one blackout, ramping flicker, dies, next word relights.
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: DripDown
elements.desc: Red glyphs fade in and grow two thin round-ended drips each, hold, fade out, next word.
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: SlowApproach
elements.desc: Phrase creeps from 50% size and near-invisible with cubic ease-in growth and rising tremor, then 3.5x accent burst, black, repeat.
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: GhostTwitch
elements.desc: Two semi-transparent ghost layers (red + text colour) drift, then ~1/s 0.3 s bursts jump them sideways at 24 Hz while body jitters.
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: CharSwap
elements.desc: Each letter flickers 0.55 s in accent hopping between source/target/random at 14 Hz, then locks to the next sentence's letter.
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: MirrorReflection
elements.desc: Word with upside-down 30% reflection that fades and sways; both mirror left-right for 0.1 s twice per word (reflection 0.3 s late).
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: Flashlight
elements.desc: Near-black frame, text at 5% brightness; a soft wandering beam reveals the text and lightly lifts the background.
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: MeltStretch
elements.desc: Letters pinned at top are pulled down with accelerating ease to per-letter 1.8-3.4x, swaying/narrowing like melting; fade out, next word.
elements.use: horror / suspense kinetic typography, short ominous phrases.

elements.title: Audio Waveform Hook
elements.desc: Full-width mirrored bar waveform driven by deterministic pseudo-audio, bars fading in from the centre out, with a hook line and a tiny scrub/timecode row. Use for "turn the sound on", voice-over, podcast and audio-first hooks.
elements.use: audio-first hooks, VO or podcast clips, music teasers, "sound on" prompts.

elements.title: Aurora Bloom Background Flip
elements.desc: A pale ground with a purple and orange soft-focus bloom rising from the bottom, then the whole background darkens to near-black in about 0.37 s while the blobs dim to an afterglow. The copy blurs out, a pause follows, and the new line blurs in. Use for a narrative turn or a light-to-dark section change.
elements.use: a narrative turning point ("for years... then everything changed"); a brand beat that moves from setup to the accent line; a light-to-dark section change.

elements.title: Aurora Orb
elements.desc: Northern-lights veils swirling and blurring inside a dark disc, brighter with the audio level.
elements.use: AI-assistant/voice/music reels: listening, speaking and thinking beats.

elements.title: Autolayout Gap Dial
elements.desc: One spacing value drives a stack of nav blocks, measure lines, badges and a big dial readout in lockstep, then springs back with overshoot. Use for 'change one number, the UI follows' product shots.
elements.use: design-tool or low-code selling points where a parameter visibly reflows a layout (gap, radius, padding).

elements.title: Avatar Bracket Carousel
elements.desc: Fill-in sentence (Your ___ agent). Four corner focus brackets stay pinned in the sentence while an avatar queue springs through them three times and the role label swaps in sync. Use for 'one slot, many roles' capability lines.
elements.use: one-slot-many-roles enumerations, team/persona/preset product lines, a single core sentence shot.

elements.title: Bar Chart 3D
elements.desc: Row of 3D bars that grow up with a stagger and spring, hero bar highlighted, camera at a low 3/4 angle with a slow drift.
elements.use: growth/comparison data beats with depth, product launch stats.

elements.title: Bar Chart Grow
elements.desc: Staggered vertical bars growing from baseline with count-up values and category labels.
elements.use: comparing 3-8 categories, month series, rankings.

elements.title: Basic 3D Scene
elements.desc: impress.js-style spatial deck. Cards sit in 3D space with their own pose (move, tilt, lie on their side) and the camera flies to each by applying the inverse of the card pose, ending on a pulled-back overview. Use to turn a three-step story into a journey through space.
elements.use: concept / roadmap / three-step explainers that should feel spatial instead of slide-by-slide.

elements.title: Beat Cut Moves
elements.desc: Paparazzi-style flash cut: three white flashes hard-cut one picture into three tighter crops (wide, card, close-up) on shrinking intervals, then a long hold on the close-up. Use to make a highlight or key number feel like a camera burst.
elements.use: award-style moments, a key number or line that deserves a "snapshot" beat, rhythm-driven highlight sections where the cut itself is the beat.

elements.title: Beat Flash Pulse
elements.desc: Wrapper that gives its children a zoom pulse and short white/colour flash on each beat of a bpm; CapCut-style beat punch.
elements.use: music-synced punch on any scene or photo, beat cuts.

elements.title: Beat Grid Timeline
elements.desc: Beat ticks (taller every 4th) over coloured scene blocks that scaleY from the top, staggered, plus a caption line.
elements.use: Showing structure/cuts on a beat grid, edit breakdowns, music-sync explainers.

elements.title: Beat Orbs Background
elements.desc: 14 seeded blurred orbs drift and swell with beat pulse + energy; theme gradient hard-cuts on the beat with bloom-in and an expanding shockwave ring.
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: Beat Step List Theme Cycle
elements.desc: Three-channel beat clock: a word list steps up one row per beat, a fixed centre capsule catches each new word and changes colour, and the background changes on the same beat. Use for multi-theme or multi-mood product showcases and dense music-synced passages.
elements.use: "one product, many moods" sections (modern, playful, bold, ...), the densest part of a piece, passages locked to music.

elements.title: Before After Reveal
elements.desc: Before/after wipe: a circle clip-path grows from 50% 45% revealing FINAL over RAW, with a RAW/FINAL label pill.
elements.use: Before/after comparisons, 'how it was made' reels, grade/edit reveals.

elements.title: Before After Slider Scrub
elements.desc: Before/after comparison slider: two stacked versions of the same screen, a divider bar that swings fast to the right and then scrubs slowly back, revealing the new version as it passes. Use for "before vs after" proof of an AI enhancement or optimisation.
elements.use: an AI enhancement, optimisation or refactor needs a one-shot "before vs after" proof on the same screen or image.

elements.title: Bezier Source Converge Merge
elements.desc: Four source nodes each connect by a thin bezier path to one hub; paths draw on in a stagger, nodes slide along their own curves and shrink in three stages as if swallowed, accent packets ride the paths, then the paths erase backwards and only the hub and caption remain.
elements.use: "many sources, one entry" mechanics: integrations, aggregation, unified inbox/ingest.

elements.title: Bleep Censor
elements.desc: Caption 'LABEL: value' pops with spring and stroke, then a black box swaps the value for a yellow tilted *BLEEP*
elements.use: comedic reveal/redaction gags (age, price, name).

elements.title: Blinds Wipe
elements.desc: Staggered strips open from their centre lines to reveal scene B.
elements.use: graphic, rhythmic scene changes.

elements.title: Bloom Mark + Step Chips
elements.desc: A neutral radial bloom badge (eight petals open one by one inside a glowing rounded square), a wordmark that rises, then numbered step chips that stagger up. Use for "how it works" in 3 steps, tool intros and product reveals.
elements.use: a tool/product reveal followed by a short numbered process ("01 Describe, 02 Generate, 03 Ship").

elements.title: Blur Dissolve
elements.desc: Scene A->B crossfade with blur and scale; takes two children.
elements.use: soft, dreamy scene changes, time jumps.

elements.title: Blur Slide
elements.desc: Headline words float out of blur one by one: y offset, blur radius and opacity all ride one shared eased progress, and the subtitle follows in staggered words before the headline finishes. The default, low-energy text reveal for headline and subtitle pairs.
elements.use: nearly any headline + subtitle pair; product page first-screen copy; chapter subtitles; the default text reveal when it needs to be professional without stealing the scene.

elements.title: Bokeh Orbs
elements.desc: 12 soft radial-gradient orbs drifting upward with sine sway, alternating blush/gold; ambient full-bleed background.
elements.use: warm ambient depth behind cards, end cards, soft intros

elements.title: Border Beam
elements.desc: Card with a travelling light beam orbiting its border (conic gradient shell + glow).
elements.use: highlighting a KPI/feature card, AI-input or premium UI card.

elements.title: Bottom Push Stack Wipe
elements.desc: Chapter change where each new full-screen chapter (own saturated colour, content pinned to it) pushes up from the bottom edge and shoves the old one off the top, same easing and speed for both layers.
elements.use: multi-chapter product films, one selling point per colour, a page-flip rhythm across the whole film.

elements.title: Bounce Caption
elements.desc: Words accumulate one per step with a damped-spring pop; newest word highlighted; thick stroke and shadow
elements.use: short-form captions, hook phrases

elements.title: Brace Expand
elements.desc: A tiny pair of curly braces appears at the centre, springs open once with a single overshoot to title size, and the title is revealed through a clip that is locked to the braces' inner edges, like a curtain pulled from the middle. Use for a one-symbol title reveal in developer or technical product pieces.
elements.use: a developer or technical product title card; chapter openers; a minimal one-beat reveal that a single symbol can carry; a short centred title.

elements.title: Brand Frame Snap
elements.desc: A brand-colour frame grows around the whole screen before a product window drops inside it. When the mode changes, the frame colour, the window layout and the mode chip all flip on one frame, with a white flash and a springy thickness bounce. Use as a dual-mode packaging layer over real screen recordings.
elements.use: a two-mode or two-chapter product film where colour codes the mode (blue = mode A, orange = mode B); branding real screen recordings without a logo watermark.

elements.title: Brand Ink Open
elements.desc: Opening brand card. An ink crosshair is drawn, the wordmark is pressed in letter by letter (scale plus blur), a typewriter kicker is typed, the lockup holds still for one second, then lifts away and dissolves. Use for a brand opener or any title card that must give the name before the product appears.
elements.use: brand openers; any opening that gives the name before the product; a calm first beat that leaves room to build energy afterwards.

elements.title: Brief Prompt Composer
elements.desc: A prompt typed into a floating card, send button wakes up, pointer presses it with a ripple, and a result card springs in below. Use for "brief it in one sentence" beats.
elements.use: AI/agent product demos, "describe it, get it" explainers, onboarding.

elements.title: Browser Page Build
elements.desc: Browser window (traffic lights, URL bar) whose page builds in block by block: header, file/row list and a README-style text block.
elements.use: repo/website/app page reveals, "here is the page" beats.

elements.title: Calendar Fill
elements.desc: Month grid whose days fill in one by one with a tick or colour; counter shows days done. For streaks, 30-day plans and habit recaps.
elements.use: 30-day challenges, streaks, content calendars.

elements.title: Camera Path Diagram
elements.desc: Plan-view camera move: dashed path draws on, numbered shot markers pop, a camera glyph with a view cone travels the path aimed at the subject, shot chips light up in turn.
elements.use: explaining camera moves, shot lists, storyboard overviews, "you choose where the camera goes".

elements.title: Canvas Materialize Moves
elements.desc: Content materialising on an open canvas, two ways: list rows arc out of a panel and morph into canvas cards (panel), or a typed prompt grows a tree level by level with lines leading the nodes (cascade). Use for 'generated result lands on the board' beats.
elements.use: AI or collaboration tools where results land on a canvas: batch import (panel) or one sentence growing a structure such as a diagram or ER map (cascade).

elements.title: Card Fan Deck
elements.desc: Section cards stack over each other (covered cards step back but keep headers), the stack releases upward, then one reference card fans out around a shared bottom pivot and rotates into a flat offset deck. Use for one-becomes-many and scroll-stacking beats.
elements.use: feature lists, "one idea, four variants", scroll-driven section reveals.

elements.title: Card Flip Reveal
elements.desc: A column of feature cards flips 180 degrees on the Y axis, staggered; the front is the feature, the back lands a big result number, with angle-linked shading and an edge sheen that peaks when the card is edge-on.
elements.use: feature-to-result pairs (a UI or feature on the front, its metric on the back), bento-style recaps.

elements.title: Card Flock Tumble
elements.desc: Three page cards tumble in from edge-on along one Catmull-Rom spline, settle into a staircase and keep spinning slowly, get sucked into the centre, burst into a single turbulent smoke ring and slam a giant word.
elements.use: energy peaks: many pages collapsing into one slogan, neon/aurora dark-ground tone.

elements.title: Card Shrink End Card
elements.desc: End card where a full-bleed frame springs down into a tilted gold-edged card, corner pill pops, text lines rise, gold rule draws, fade to black
elements.use: closing a reel on a final frame turned into a keepsake card.

elements.title: Card Stack 3D
elements.desc: Five generated-texture UI cards (profile, chart, hero, inbox, goal ring; no DOM) fan out in 3D, the group swings, and the front card lifts and flips to show its back. Optional owner headshots on two cards.
elements.use: app/feature teasers, "pick a card" reveals, product tiers, dashboards in 3D.

elements.title: Card Stack to Grid
elements.desc: A stack of cards fans out, glides into a grid, then flips one-by-one in 3D to reveal faces.
elements.use: feature grids, portfolio/lineup reveals, product catalog.

elements.title: Card Stack
elements.desc: Nine cards spring up one by one into a physical stack (each landing presses the stack down), then fan out about a pivot below the cards; the centre card is pulled out with a sheen and a headline rises. Use for 'a library of N things'.
elements.use: template/recipe/library reveals, "first the whole, then the individuals" shots.

elements.title: Carousel 3D
elements.desc: Eight cards on a 3D ring; the whole ring turns about Y while every card stays upright (double-sided same-orientation faces), the card facing the camera lights up, and a caption rolls with each step. Loops seamlessly.
elements.use: galleries of a set of things, looping backgrounds, "browse the range" shots.

elements.title: Chalk Doodles
elements.desc: Hand-drawn chalk doodles (spiral, star, heart, squiggle, sparkle) draw on around a head point, boil at 10 fps and pop on the beat
elements.use: reaction/emotion beats around a face or subject, cute "thinking / in love" accents.

elements.title: Channel Split Glitch
elements.desc: Wraps any full-frame scene; at each hit the scene splits into R/G/B copies with sliced displacement, then settles.
elements.use: a hard impact beat or a glitch cut on top of an existing scene.

elements.title: Chapter Pill Glass
elements.desc: Frosted-glass pill (backdrop blur, hairline border) with a dot, main label and secondary label that glides in on each cut and fades before the next. Use for chapter/section tags over footage.
elements.use: labelling chapters over busy footage

elements.title: Char Cascade
elements.desc: Per-character stagger drop-in with rotation, blur and overshoot.
elements.use: punchy headlines, titles

elements.title: Chart Live Moves
elements.desc: Three chart-as-story moves in one component: a live oscilloscope trace with one spike, 320 dots that regroup from scatter into clusters, columns and a big number, and an axis-rescale shock where the new value bursts past the ceiling and the y axis rescales. Use inside a data section, one variant per point.
elements.use: a data passage needs one concrete argument: "it is live" (`oscilloscope`), "every number is a person" (`dot-swarm`), or "growth does not fit the chart" (`axis-shock`).

elements.title: Chat Thread
elements.desc: Generic messenger UI that plays a scripted conversation with typing dots, spring bubbles, timestamps, read ticks, photo bubble and auto-scroll.
elements.use: a scripted text conversation told from one participant's side (`me` right, `them` left), 9:16 story/ad/skit.

elements.title: Chip Grid Single Select Blackout
elements.desc: Single-select demo: option chips stagger in, one is pressed (1-frame grey flash, 5-frame linear blackout with white text and a tiny spring) while the rest dim to 18% without moving, then the chip lifts and a settled price appears. Use for plan or tier pickers.
elements.use: single-select, plan or tier pickers and 'what happens once I choose it' cause-and-effect shots (price or parameter settling).

elements.title: Circle Match Iris
elements.desc: Match-cut iris that opens from the centre of a real circular element (an avatar) while a ring chart in the new scene grows from the same circle - solid disc hollows into a ring, the iris is pushed open by it, then the ring sweeps and the number counts up.
elements.use: a circular foreground element (avatar, icon, round button) followed by a circular chart or progress ring; "this person to this person's data".

elements.title: Clay Camera Moves
elements.desc: Director view of the clay set: a camera glyph travels a dashed 3D path through dolly, orbit and crane shots with numbered markers and a live camera inset. Use to explain camera moves.
elements.use: explaining dolly/orbit/crane, shot lists, camera-direction tutorials.

elements.title: Clay Object Edit
elements.desc: 3D editor beat on the clay set: select an object, show 3D move/scale gizmo handles, drag it, scale it and swap it for another object with a live DOM readout. Use for 3D editing/UI explainers.
elements.use: 3D editor/tool explainers, "select, move, scale, swap" demos.

elements.title: Clay Set
elements.desc: Reusable prop-driven gray clay 3D set (table, mug, lamp, plant, box on a shadowed ground) with camera presets, staggered reveal, selection tag and per-object overrides. Use as the shared stage for 3D explainers.
elements.use: 3D explainers, product/desk scenes, any beat that needs one consistent 3D world driven by props.

elements.title: Cloner Depth Echo
elements.desc: One card is 'copied' into 7 clones lined up along Z (staggered springs, fading to outlines, vanishing point at the upper left), the column holds, then all snap back with an ease-in; the hero pulses, its shot slots light and a counter shows the number.
elements.use: "one equals many" scale statements: one prompt, many outputs; batch/variation claims.

elements.title: Code Card
elements.desc: Editor-style code card (tab, line numbers, syntax colours, status bar) where characters type in, the border locks to the accent and a tilted Chip punches in. Use for a snippet or promo code to copy.
elements.use: a code snippet, config line or promo code the viewer should copy; dev tips.

elements.title: Coin Flip 3D
elements.desc: Gold coin tossed up, spinning on its horizontal axis, landing with a bounce and settling to show one face (heads text or symbol).
elements.use: decisions, money, "heads or tails" and payoff beats.

elements.title: Collab Cursor Moves
elements.desc: Named collaboration cursors as actors: five staggered spring fly-ins onto a whiteboard, two-frequency drift, one cursor parks on a caret and types a headline, then all gather round the card. Use as a 'the team is here' ambience layer.
elements.use: collaboration or whiteboard scenes that need a 'people are present' warmth layer, any duration; one cursor can take a typing cameo.

elements.title: Comic Explosion Balloon
elements.desc: Two jagged comic starbursts (orange then paper) with ink outline from a fixed spike table, spring scale-pop with a shout word inside
elements.use: shock/impact beats, covers that hide a surprise, "boom/wow" punchlines.

elements.title: Confetti Burst Ring
elements.desc: Expanding shockwave ring plus 26 flat confetti rectangles with air drag, gravity, flip and rotation that fade out in 1.8 s; point burst for landings and reveals
elements.use: accenting a landing/impact at a known point.

elements.title: Confetti Cannons
elements.desc: Two confetti cannons below the bottom corners fire 120 flat pieces that drag, flutter and fall slowly, fading out when they enter text rectangles; celebratory layer under headlines
elements.use: a party or finale moment with text on screen.

elements.title: Corner Info Card
elements.desc: Floating tilted card pinned to a safe-zone corner with pill title and italic body; springs in from 160px above/below, floats on a sine, fades out.
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: Count-Up Counter (digit roll)
elements.desc: Eased odometer count with tabular digit cells and thousands separators. Variants: atxt-21-odometer.
elements.use: KPIs, stats, view counts

elements.title: Countdown Arc Scatter
elements.desc: A dial of numbers sweeps past on a large arc and stops on the hero number; the hero flies off the dial into the first glyph of the title while the other numbers blur away. Use for countdown or duration claims.
elements.use: countdown or duration promises ("5 min to install"), a single data-reveal beat, a light-background short that needs a dial feel.

elements.title: Crane Rise Reveal
elements.desc: Crane-style rise that reveals a full dashboard. The camera opens on one data row at 3x, holds, then lifts and pulls back on a single eased curve while rows wash in, a KPI counts up, and the tracked row flips to Rendered. Use as an opening that goes from one detail to the whole product, or to show that a single row is one cell of a large wall.
elements.use: openers that go from detail to whole product; content-rich products where the size of the wall is the selling point; as the mirror of a top-down dive that lands on a hero (use one of the two per film).

elements.title: Crash Zoom Punch
elements.desc: Wide hold, target lock, then a 12-frame ease-in crash zoom onto one card. Two landings via `variant`: bounce (overshoot and recover, elastic) or impact (hard stop with decaying screen shake, weight). Use to slam the viewer's eye onto one module.
elements.use: a feature "call-out" shot that must put the eye on one card or metric; impact variant for emphasis level.

elements.title: Credits Crack Wait
elements.desc: Fake end-credits crawl, record-scratch tilt + sepia flash, seeded crack lines drawing across the screen and a stroked "WAIT." slam with shake.
elements.use: Fake ending that interrupts into a second act/twist.

elements.title: Crystal Gem 3D
elements.desc: Faceted gem (flat-shaded octahedron) that spins and bobs with a sweeping highlight and tinted glow disc behind it.
elements.use: value/reward/premium beats, "unlock" payoffs.

elements.title: Cta Arrow Credits
elements.desc: CTA end screen: mono kicker + big italic headline, a hand-drawn arrow that draws on, link line, MADE WITH pills popping, struck-through NO pills.
elements.use: Outro/CTA, credits, 'made with' tool lists, what-I-did-not-use jokes.

elements.title: Cube Nav 3D
elements.desc: A 3D cube with a label on each face that tumbles to show the next face every 45 frames, with an eased hold; for menus, features and sections.
elements.use: feature tours, chapter menus, "6 things" lists.

elements.title: Cursor Click
elements.desc: Cursor follows a quadratic arc to a target, dips on press and emits ripple rings.
elements.use: simulating a user clicking a button/UI element.

elements.title: Cursor Flyover
elements.desc: One continuous camera tours four regions of a single-page UI while a cursor leads it, clicks (ripple) and triggers a UI response at each stop, then pulls back to an overview. Use for feature tours of a single-page product.
elements.use: product tours where one dashboard / workbench page has four features to show in one shot; the cursor is the viewer's attention proxy.

elements.title: Curveball Wipe
elements.desc: Transition: a seamed baseball spins 1080deg along a quadratic curve with a 10-ghost trail while a circle clip-path opens from the right edge to reveal scene B. Two children A/B.
elements.use: scene-to-scene cut on a playful/sports/comedy beat.

elements.title: Dashed Connector
elements.desc: Dashed line drawn on along a curved path between two nodes via mask (dash 4.5/3 x stroke)
elements.use: flows, diagrams, step linking

elements.title: Data Annotation
elements.desc: One bar chart reading: bars grow 20f, counter rolls to exact value, one leader-line callout says why it matters.
elements.use: reports, investor updates, data journalism

elements.title: Dataviz Landscape Open
elements.desc: Dark-field brand opener. Eleven stream lines merge into one trunk over a projected ground plane, tagged ID pins float on the lines, depth-of-field layers separate near, mid and far, and a slow camera flies over the field to a title. Use as an abstract "every stream becomes one product" opening before a bright product section or a wordmark.
elements.use: brand-level abstract openers (the "data universe" idea); an ambient opening for one film (once per film); a dark intro before a bright product section.

elements.title: Date Slate
elements.desc: Opening slate: kicker, big date, tick-mark bar and time code; digits roll in then a hold. For news-style, event and recap reels.
elements.use: episode/event openers, "what happened on" recaps.

elements.title: Deck Deal Fly-in
elements.desc: A physical card stack is dealt onto a perspective board in reading order with hard-accelerating gaps; each card arcs in z, overshoots and presses; the camera tilts up and back to a runway overview with a tagline and landed-count readout.
elements.use: "look how many pages/cards" surges, template-library launches, energetic wall-fill moments.

elements.title: Delta Stat Card
elements.desc: Big number card with a label, a green/red delta arrow with percentage and a thin underline sweep; the number counts up.
elements.use: KPI beats, growth/drop callouts.

elements.title: Depth Layer Moves
elements.desc: Multiplane parallax slider. One drive moves a blurred far page (0.35x), a sharp reading layer of cards (0.7x) and big blurred floating pills (1.4x); a title stays pinned (0x) and the hero card lifts when the slide settles. Use to give flat cards or screenshots thickness.
elements.use: a card deck, list or whole-page sideways tour that should feel like it has depth.

elements.title: Dice Roll 3D
elements.desc: A six-sided die tumbles in, bounces and settles on a chosen face (prop `result` 1-6) with pip textures drawn in code.
elements.use: games, chance, "roll the dice" beats.

elements.title: DNA Helix 3D
elements.desc: Double helix of two bead strands joined by base-pair rungs, rotating about its vertical axis and unrolling in from the top.
elements.use: biology/health/science reels, "code of life" metaphors.

elements.title: Doc Park and Pill Deal
elements.desc: A document parks small (shrinks, never fades) while still scrolling; three conclusion pills are dealt on a slow narration beat with word-by-word deepening captions and a highlighter sweep on the evidence sentence behind each pill.
elements.use: "source then conclusions" explainers, research summaries, narrated findings.

elements.title: Document Typewriter Reveal
elements.desc: A floating document window writes its own body lines in beat pairs with a caret riding the wipe edge, highlights an @-mention after each line, then drops history rows into the foot of the window. Use for document, report or notes features.
elements.use: documentation, report or notes feature shots; the densest information beat in a reel.

elements.title: Dot Grid Background
elements.desc: Multi-layer dot grid whose layers parallax with a camera move; backdrop for cards and headlines.
elements.use: you need a tech/blueprint backdrop that implies camera movement.

elements.title: Dotted Globe Spin
elements.desc: Fibonacci dot sphere with brighter land dots, slow frame-driven spin and tilt, fresnel rim glow and optional halftone or sonar shader looks. Use as a rotating globe background or hero.
elements.use: hero/background globe for launches, "worldwide" claims, intros.

elements.title: Draw SVG Trace
elements.desc: An ink line with a visible pen head traces a card outline (pathLength=1 dash trick), flashes dark on closing, hands over to the card hairline while content inks in, then a marker underline is drawn under the key word.
elements.use: "now we talk about this one" element call-outs, hand-drawn emphasis, headline underline growth.

elements.title: Easings Visualizer
elements.desc: Row of labelled squares sliding left to right at once, one per easing curve (linear, ease-out cubic, in-out, back, bounce, elastic), so curves can be compared.
elements.use: motion-design explainers, picking an easing for a reel.

elements.title: Edge Glow Frame
elements.desc: Ambient frame around the whole screen: a masked, blurred conic-gradient border that rotates and thickens with the audio level.
elements.use: AI-assistant/voice/music reels: listening, speaking and thinking beats.

elements.title: Egg Hatch Reveal
elements.desc: Egg SVG drops in, squashes on landing, zigzag crack draws, halves fly apart and a stroked pop-in title appears over a rotating conic sunburst and scrolling halftone dots.
elements.use: Surprise/easter-egg reveal, gender/prize/twist reveal, stinger.

elements.title: Element Body Moves (Contact Shadow Lift)
elements.desc: Contact-shadow lift - on a tilted desk a card rises along its normal while its shadow, a separate body lying on the desk, grows, blurs, fades and drifts away from the light; called cards drop back with a squash, the last one springs up and stays.
elements.use: picking cards one by one in 2.5D scenes, believable "lifted off the table" emphasis.

elements.title: Emoji Sparkle Burst
elements.desc: Emoji particles with gravity/fade, popping 4-point sparkles and die-cut heart/star stickers with white outline and hard shadow
elements.use: celebratory/cute reaction beats, wink or punchline accents.

elements.title: Equalizer Orb
elements.desc: Dark disc with 15 rounded equalizer bars, tallest at the centre; heights follow the audio level with a per-bar wobble.
elements.use: AI-assistant/voice/music reels: listening, speaking and thinking beats.

elements.title: Extruded Title 3D
elements.desc: A short word built from box-voxel glyphs (compact 5x7 font defined in the file); letters drop in staggered with bounce, then the camera swings 30 degrees. Bevel look from an inset lighter cap box.
elements.use: 3D hero titles, level-up / win moments, short words (2 to 6 letters per line).

elements.title: Film Strip Slide
elements.desc: Transition: scene A slides out inside a sprocketed film strip while scene B slides in on the next frame; vertical strip, frame gap lines.
elements.use: photo/recap montages, nostalgia cuts.

elements.title: Floating Card + Pill Tag
elements.desc: Tilted floating card with soft double shadow, rotated pill tag, entrance spring and idle bob; children slot
elements.use: feature/UI callouts, screenshots placeholder

elements.title: Flying Words
elements.desc: Twenty-two keywords spread around a tunnel fly in from far away, pass the camera and fade on a life curve, looping seamlessly; a fixed title sits in front. Use as a background layer for keyword or capability lists.
elements.use: keyword or capability lists as a moving background behind a title; intro or outro filler that needs depth.

elements.title: Fracture
elements.desc: A 5x5 poster splits into 25 tiles of one shared poster image that spin in from 3D scatter and settle back into place in a Manhattan-distance ripple from the centre; the whole poster holds with a short headline, then the tiles scatter outward and fly off-frame. Use for a brand or poster reveal that goes from chaos to a formed image.
elements.use: a brand or poster reveal as the first shot ("from chaos to formed"), or a hard transition where the second half of the cycle is cut in.

elements.title: Freeze Polaroid
elements.desc: Slow-motion glitch decay, then a freeze: the frame shrinks into a tilted white-bordered polaroid with a caption strip, flash, sparkles and a rate readout (0.35x / FREEZE 0.00x). Use for hold-the-moment transitions.
elements.use: photo-moment freeze frames, scene-to-scene stills, highlights.

elements.title: FUI HUD Reticle Lock-On
elements.desc: A HUD reticle locks onto a target. Four L-shaped corner brackets fly in from off-screen, overshoot as they shrink, then snap onto the target's corners with a flash and a popped label. Use to point at a subject while the footage keeps moving.
elements.use: "look here" call-outs where an arrow or red circle would freeze the picture; a single target per film (one lock-on per target).

elements.title: Galaxy Orb
elements.desc: Glassy bubble holding a rotating seeded starfield over a nebula gradient; star twinkle strength follows the audio level.
elements.use: AI-assistant/voice/music reels: listening, speaking and thinking beats.

elements.title: Gauge Readout Moves
elements.desc: Two gauge-style number reveals: needle-sweep self-test (three dials swing to full scale, then spring back onto their values, staggered) and tape-scroll with a fixed pointer (the scale sprints past and brakes on the new limit). Use for dashboard reveal rituals or one big metric jump.
elements.use: a dashboard opens with a "system ready" beat (`needle-sweep`, three dials), or a single metric jumps and the distance should be seen (`tape-scroll`).

elements.title: Glass Credit Card
elements.desc: Frosted-glass payment card that tilts in 3D-style with a moving light sweep; chip, number groups and name type on in sequence.
elements.use: fintech/product explainers, "your card" beats.

elements.title: Glass Orb
elements.desc: Iridescent glassmorphism orb: spinning conic colour aura under a glass sheen, inner rim shadow and a soft top highlight.
elements.use: AI-assistant/voice/music reels: listening, speaking and thinking beats.

elements.title: Glass Panel Refraction
elements.desc: Layered frosted-glass panes over a colourful moving backdrop with blur, refraction, light border, reflection sweep and parallax; headline plus stat.
elements.use: product / UI / launch visuals that want glassmorphism (frosted, translucent, layered).

elements.title: Glass Pill Dictation Typing
elements.desc: A fixed-width frosted-glass pill lands at 1.25x with warm light inside (faint left, dense right); a dictated sentence types at constant speed and the light, plus the ambient sun behind it, retreats until only neutral glass is left. Use as the quiet beat for voice/AI input.
elements.use: voice or AI input bars appearing, 'talk to it' prompts, or one quiet beat between two high-energy sections.

elements.title: Glitch Cycle
elements.desc: One slot cycles through status phrases that melt into random glyphs and re-solidify, with RGB split, jitter and tear bands driven by one glitch density; a progress rail tracks the steps. Use for loading, build, deploy or render status narration.
elements.use: loading, build, deploy or render status narration; technical intros that need a machine voice.

elements.title: Glitch Outline Slam
elements.desc: Glitch-decay bursts over a huge outline-only word, then a solid word slams in with a decaying channel-offset text shadow. Use for punchy two-part words.
elements.use: style/look names, hype titles, beat hits.

elements.title: Glitch RGB Slice
elements.desc: Wraps children; seeded RGB channel split plus random horizontal slice offsets during bursts. Variants: atxt-25-signal-glitch.
elements.use: tech/cyber hits, error moments, beat accents.

elements.title: Globe Arc Routes
elements.desc: City pins on a dotted globe joined by great-circle arcs that draw on in sequence with travelling packets; the view eases to frame each arc. Use for network, shipping, user-reach and route stories.
elements.use: connections between places, global rollout, flight/shipping routes.

elements.title: Globe Zoom to Pin
elements.desc: Globe spins to bring a target lat/lng to centre, the camera dives in, a pin with pulsing rings pops and a DOM label card (inside the safe rect) joins to it by a drawn line. Use for "this location" callouts.
elements.use: location reveals, store/office/event spotlights, travel stories.

elements.title: Glow Orbs and Flylines
elements.desc: Dark-ground light moves: three glass nodes linked by glowing bezier flylines that hand off between them, with the orb behind each node surging on the same landing frame; also an ambient orb-and-glass-card mode and an arcs-only mode.
elements.use: the one dark-ground segment of a film; data flow or metric linkage ("this signal feeds that node"); ambient background behind a glass card; a three-stop relay that closes a section.

elements.title: Gold Dust Burst
elements.desc: Seeded glowing gold dust that fans up and falls with gravity, followed by an outlined gold number with glow and spring scale-in.
elements.use: Celebration beat: milestone number, wish/candle moment, age or count reveal.

elements.title: Gold Portrait Intro
elements.desc: Suit-style portrait title: mono kicker, blurred letter-rise caps name, drawing gold rule, two-line "Fifty years / in the making" rise over a bottom gradient, vignette and a gold frame that strokes on.
elements.use: Name/title card over a portrait or video background; milestone, tribute, awards intro.

elements.title: Goo Metaballs
elements.desc: SVG gooey metaballs (blur + alpha threshold) that split from a core and re-merge.
elements.use: organic loaders, logo reveals, liquid transitions.

elements.title: Googly Eyes Sticker
elements.desc: Googly eyes whose pupils swing like a damped pendulum re-kicked every beat; pop in with a spring; eye positions are props so it can sit on any face/subject. Pill caption slams in.
elements.use: comic freeze-frame, "stunning" reaction beats, mascots, product faces.

elements.title: Gradient Blobs
elements.desc: Blurred drifting brand-colour blobs (silk/aurora) as full-frame animated background.
elements.use: you want soft premium colour atmosphere behind text.

elements.title: Gradient Shine Text
elements.desc: Gradient-clipped text with a looping diagonal highlight sweep.
elements.use: hero word/brand name accent

elements.title: Gradient Transition
elements.desc: A background that morphs between linear, radial and conic CSS gradients by interpolating angle, colour stops, centre and radius, cross-fading the gradient type in a narrow window so both layers keep moving.
elements.use: living background for typography or a cut-out subject; chapter colour variation.

elements.title: Gradient Word Sweep
elements.desc: Only the key word is energised: a gradient wipes across it left to right with a bright wavefront, then thin magenta lightning flickers between the letters over a steady glow. Use to charge a single benefit word in a headline.
elements.use: charging one verb or benefit word in a headline ("faster", "one prompt"); an energy peak in a text beat.

elements.title: Grain Dissolve
elements.desc: A sentence destabilises into boiling grain under a hatched selection box, the grain condenses into a larger glowing short mark, displacement decays to zero and the word locks in.
elements.use: closing "Now Live" announcements; compressing a long line into a short brand mark.

elements.title: Graze Face Tour
elements.desc: Low, steep-tilt camera grazing across a UI like terrain (tree, top bar, list rows). Text hovers above the surface with a same-shape soft shadow and drops onto it in travel order, shadow shrinking to zero on landing. Use to tour feature regions of a dark neon UI.
elements.use: feature-area tours that treat the UI as a landscape; dark ground with neon rim light; content completes itself region by region as the camera passes.

elements.title: Grid Mosaic
elements.desc: 3x3 mosaic of tiles popping in on a fixed order, a word slamming per beat, then an in-cubic x3 zoom into the centre tile (transition into the next shot).
elements.use: Hard cut between shot sets, "many looks" hooks, montage intros.

elements.title: Grid Paper Background
elements.desc: Graph-paper background with fine and bold grid lines, a red margin line and a slow diagonal drift; notebook/blueprint base layer.
elements.use: explainers, notebook looks, under hand-drawn elements.

elements.title: Ground Track Globe
elements.desc: Wireframe-style globe with a lat/long grid; an orbit ground-track curve draws across it and a marker dot follows, camera slowly orbiting.
elements.use: orbit/flight-path/route explainers, satellite and launch reels.

elements.title: Gyroscope 3D
elements.desc: Three nested rings spinning on different axes around a glowing core, like a gyroscope or armillary sphere.
elements.use: tech/AI "system" beats, loading, orbit/precision metaphors.

elements.title: Halftone Cut Transition
elements.desc: Wraps children; around each cut the frame becomes ink dots on cream paper, dot size following luminance (CSS threshold trick). Use for hard cuts between clips that need a print-style flash.
elements.use: montage cuts on the beat, retro/print look

elements.title: Halftone Fade
elements.desc: Halftone dot field dense at the bottom edge fading to the top, behind a headline
elements.use: poster/editorial backgrounds

elements.title: Halftone Sunburst Background
elements.desc: Rotating sunburst rays with a halftone dot fade from centre; comic/pop-art base layer in two colours.
elements.use: pop/comic punches, hype beats, under big type.

elements.title: Halo Orb
elements.desc: Orb with a spinning conic halo ring, two tilted orbital rings and a pulsing core that grows with the audio level.
elements.use: AI-assistant/voice/music reels: listening, speaking and thinking beats.

elements.title: Handheld Shake
elements.desc: Wrapper that adds a seeded, continuous handheld camera feel (position drift, tiny roll, optional zoom breathe) to its children.
elements.use: locked-off graphics that feel too static, found-footage and vlog looks.

elements.title: Hashtag To Pill Materialize
elements.desc: A typed '#word' becomes a large pill label with a 1-frame hard cut, holds, shrinks and slides left into the page's tag slot, and a second hard cut reveals the finished page: two hard cuts framing one slide. Use for tag, category or keyword feature demos.
elements.use: tag, category or keyword feature segments (typing a tag in a notes app, topic grouping); 'type -> becomes a UI entity -> settles into the finished page' narratives.

elements.title: Headline Newspaper Spin
elements.desc: Classic spinning newspaper that zooms from small to full-frame with a headline, masthead and column lines; lands with a hold.
elements.use: news/recap openers, "breaking" hooks.

elements.title: Headline + Prompt Card
elements.desc: Headline with eyebrow + accent words, blurred app window behind, floating prompt card with typed quote and blinking cursor, two tilted pill tags.
elements.use: explaining a prompt/message/query, AI-tool style explainers

elements.title: Heart Counter
elements.desc: Glass pill with a heart outline that fills and pulses on each tick and an n/total count whose number rises in; for counting events (kisses, likes, wins)
elements.use: tallying repeated moments in a video with a corner counter.

elements.title: Heartbeat Push
elements.desc: Camera wrapper: lub-dub heartbeat scale pulses, slow push-in 1 to 1.07 and a diagonal screen-blend light sweep over children. Also exports Twinkle star.
elements.use: grid/collage/endcard reveals needing life

elements.title: Hero Accent Word
elements.desc: Italic accent word pops with overshoot, gold underline draws on, then a gradient shimmer sweeps through the text.
elements.use: one key word in a headline

elements.title: HUD Lock-on
elements.desc: Monospace character-grid readout: numbers roll through random glyphs then settle; corner brackets lock on in 3 steps with a tick.
elements.use: dev tools, spec walkthroughs, sci-fi/AI demos

elements.title: Icon Field Colorize
elements.desc: A field of grey keycap icons fills the frame in batches from the centre outward; after a short pause, several brand-colour waves sweep down the rows within about half a second and light every icon, then a title lands on a dark radial scrim. Use to show a large feature set first and then light it up with the brand colour.
elements.use: an opening that shows a broad feature or integration set and then lights it with the brand colour; feature-matrix or ecosystem pages; a logo lead-in.

elements.title: Icon Attention Bounce
elements.desc: A large app-style icon performs a Dock-style attention bounce: four hops, each higher than the last, squashing on every landing, neighbours rack out of focus, the camera leans in, then a feature panel springs open.
elements.use: introducing a new feature with a hero icon in the centre of the frame; "look at this" beats that lead into a panel or call to action.

elements.title: Impact Feedback
elements.desc: Hit feedback for a landing element in two strengths: hit-counter chains three card slams with a global hit-stop, damage numbers and a x1/x2/x3 combo counter; anime-impact crash-zooms into a few frames of negative with speed lines and a red/cyan colour split.
elements.use: giving a landing or collision a game-style "it hit" moment. Pick the strength ladder: hit-counter for a run of three feature points told as a combo; anime-impact for the one peak punch in the film.

elements.title: Ink Flood Handoff
elements.desc: Each glyph of a settled title dilates until the word fuses into a block, recolours and floods into the next scene panel, then the incoming title writes on. Use as a chapter or scene handoff.
elements.use: chapter breaks, title to scene transitions.

elements.title: Ink Iso House 3D
elements.desc: Pale isometric cottage drawn as ink line art: flat pale faces with dark silhouette edges, a chimney with rising smoke puffs, building up wall by wall and roof last.
elements.use: town/build/real-estate/story reels with a hand-inked look.

elements.title: Instant Replay Badge
elements.desc: Wraps a scene with an INSTANT REPLAY banner (skewed blue box, yellow hard shadow), rewind glitch/scanline look, then a slow-mo speed badge
elements.use: replaying a funny/key beat of a clip (rewind then slow-mo).

elements.title: Integration Beam
elements.desc: Three input paths draw down into a hub, glowing packets flow through it and on to a single output that pulses a green ring and check. Use for "many sources, one result".
elements.use: integrations, pipelines, automations, data flowing into one outcome.

elements.title: Integration Hub Map
elements.desc: An old document page flips a full 180 degrees into a hub page (fast flip, long soft landing, one-frame edge flash); five icons pop in on one beat, five light pipes draw in together on the second beat, then pulses flow icon to hub forever.
elements.use: "everything connects to one hub" integration reveals, old-way versus new-way flips.

elements.title: Iris Wipe
elements.desc: Shape mask (circle/diamond/square) grows from a point to reveal scene B over A.
elements.use: punchy reveal from a tap/button/subject location.

elements.title: Isometric Block Build
elements.desc: True 30-degree isometric cube stacks that drop in from 40px with a bounce, staggered diagonally, three tones per material, plus a leader-line label
elements.use: architecture/supply-chain/feature diagrams that assemble themselves.

elements.title: Judge Scorecards
elements.desc: Three held-up score signs rise on sticks with rotation; the last one droops with a bounce (sad). Caption pill slams in; optional sad-trombone cue marker.
elements.use: reaction / rating gags, review verdicts, comedy punchlines.

elements.title: Karaoke Captions
elements.desc: Word-by-word active highlight captions in 2-3 lines, anchored above the bottom 450px UI zone. Variants: atxt-41-karaoke-fill, atxt-43-ktv-two-line.
elements.use: spoken-word shorts, lyric/voiceover captions

elements.title: Keyword Highlight Sweep
elements.desc: Marker-pen highlight sweeping behind chosen keywords in a sentence, with colour flip under the edge. Variants: atxt-26-highlighter.
elements.use: emphasising 1-3 key words in a statement

elements.title: Kinetic Text Overlay
elements.desc: Transparent cue-driven text overlay - words rise in one by one with a soft shadow and an accent word, positions top/centre/bottom inside the safe zone - to lay over any footage. Use as the default caption/hook layer when the video itself is the star.
elements.use: hook words over footage, short statement cues, any "layer text after video" job.

elements.title: Kinetic Title Lockup
elements.desc: One word per beat slams in (heavy caps / big rotated italic / heavy caps) with a punch-scale cut each, then a locked-up three-line title springs up with a rotated pill. Use for hero titles and episode openers.
elements.use: opening title cards, hero hook titles, 3-part headlines.

elements.title: Lead Word Zoom Assemble
elements.desc: The first word of a line fills the frame at 2.5x and keeps pushing in, then one curve shrinks it to its final size while the line slides home and the remaining words are pushed into their slots from the right; a subtitle rises in the same window and a crash-zoom with blur hands off to the next shot.
elements.use: brand or product "Introducing" title cards, a second opening shot of a launch film, a one-line claim that should be read word by word (lead word first, then the rest of the sentence).

elements.title: Letterbox Open
elements.desc: A 5:4 letterboxed band whose black bars open to full frame on a reveal moment, with a refocus
elements.use: cinematic intro that blows open to full screen on a drop or reveal.

elements.title: Letterspace Materialize
elements.desc: A wide-tracked single-line skeleton wordmark draws itself on at once. Every letter's strokes grow continuously in the same frame and finish together, with a soft glow, over a dim landscape backdrop, and the caption fades in after. Use for a quiet brand wordmark or a chapter title in an outro or intro.
elements.use: a restrained wordmark or chapter title on a calm backdrop, where the feeling should be deliberate and premium rather than playful.

elements.title: Life Timeline Dots
elements.desc: Timeline line across the top safe edge with N labelled dots, a filled progress line and a current dot that pops 1 -> 1.9 -> 1.35. Use for staged stories (ages, chapters, steps).
elements.use: a video moves through N stages on a beat (life stages, steps, eras) and viewers need a "where are we" strip

elements.title: Light Leak
elements.desc: Warm film light-leak overlay: soft orange/pink gradient blobs drift across a frame edge and peak once, using screen blend.
elements.use: film/nostalgia texture, scene-change accents, softening a cut.

elements.title: Light Play Moves
elements.desc: Two light effects on dark grounds: spotlight-sweep, a swinging spot that reveals dim serif title text and then opens to full light; sheen-sweep, one diagonal highlight wipe across a dark metal hero card that turns toward the light once.
elements.use: a dark-ground title reveal that needs light as a second brush stroke (spotlight-sweep); a single "coronation" beat on a dark hero card (sheen-sweep).

elements.title: Light Sweep Number
elements.desc: Near-black keynote stage, hairline grid, one giant count-up number revealed by a soft light sweep, one accent.
elements.use: product launches, feature stats, AI/SaaS headline numbers

elements.title: Hand-drawn Line Boil
elements.desc: Renders shapes as wobbly hand-drawn strokes whose jitter cycles through 3 seeded variants every 5 frames (on twos); demo shows anticipation, a leap and smear streaks
elements.use: playful characters, doodle explainers, social clips.

elements.title: Line Carry Transition
elements.desc: One continuous line carries the eye from scene A to scene B - a progress bar completes, its end runs off the card, the camera pans following the pen tip, and the line turns right angles to outline scene B's frame; nothing is ever cut.
elements.use: two scenes with a graphic kinship (progress bar to card frame, underline to chart axis), a once-per-film signature transition.

elements.title: Line Chart Draw
elements.desc: Line chart that draws on with an area fill, a travelling dot and a live value tooltip.
elements.use: trends, growth curves, revenue over time.

elements.title: List Reveal
elements.desc: A list rises item by item (scale 0.82 to 1 with blur to sharp and a soft overshoot, stagger slower than UI norm) while the whole container drifts at constant slow speed so nothing is ever frozen; one highlighted row gets a sheen.
elements.use: menus, feature lists, settings lists; any list that should read item by item yet keep breathing.

elements.title: List Stack Press
elements.desc: Cards rise from below and stack; every landing presses the whole stack down 6 px and it springs back (the weight), a highlight bar grows after each landing, an odometer counter rolls one digit per card and one glaze sweeps the finished stack.
elements.use: "this adds up" accumulation: bookings, results, saved items; anything where count and weight matter.

elements.title: Live Lower Third
elements.desc: Fashion-week broadcast lower third: blinking LIVE pill, location pill, season tag, camera flash bursts, sparkle stars, pink name bar sliding in with hard shadow and a mono subtitle bar.
elements.use: event / runway / premiere / celebrity-intro broadcast looks.

elements.title: Living UI Zoom
elements.desc: HTML/SVG-rebuilt app UI with eased cursor moves, pause-then-click, 1.6x camera zoom on the detail and pull back
elements.use: product tutorials, feature launches, changelogs

elements.title: Location Pill
elements.desc: Glassy dark pill with map pin, place name and a secondary line; slides in from the left, holds, fades up before the next cut
elements.use: travel/walk reels where each scene names its place (city landmark + local-language name or street)

elements.title: Logo Reveal Line
elements.desc: A line draws across, opens vertically to reveal a logo node, wordmark tracking collapses in.
elements.use: brand sting, intro/outro, sign-off.

elements.title: Logo Roster
elements.desc: Neutral glyph tiles land one at a time big in the centre, then drop into a growing row underneath, ending with a count pill. Speed-ramp entry. Use for a list of supported tools or integrations.
elements.use: "works with X, Y, Z and more" beats; supported tools, partners, integrations.

elements.title: Logo Shrink Wordmark Lockup
elements.desc: A huge neon ring collapses into a small solid white disc, brakes with a 6% overshoot and a shockwave, and is swapped for the mark; the icon slides left and the wordmark letters slide in beside it, horizontal lockup, with an accent tagline.
elements.use: final brand sign-off from full-screen graphics to a mark + wordmark + tagline lockup.

elements.title: Look Name Lockup
elements.desc: Two-line look name (serif italic + heavy caps with stroke) slamming in 4 src frames apart, plus a persistent LOOK 02 / 04 counter pill top-right. Exports LookNameLockup and CounterPill.
elements.use: Series of looks/variants/chapters with a running index.

elements.title: Lower Third
elements.desc: Name/title bar with slide+mask reveal and exit, placed inside the safe zone above the bottom UI.
elements.use: speaker/host ID, location tags

elements.title: Lyric Words Rise
elements.desc: Lyric/title line: words spring in (opacity, rise, scale, blur), each on a half-beat position proportional to its length; emphasised words heavy uppercase with accent glow.
elements.use: beat-synced / lyric reels needing this piece.

elements.title: Magician Card Flourish
elements.desc: A blue starburst flashes for about 0.3 s, then a card is flung out of the flash point along a decelerating arc, spinning about its diagonal at 13 turns that slow as it nears the camera. It hard-freezes face-on at roughly 41% of frame height with a light pulse and a sheen sweep, and a headline and sub-line rise beneath it. Use for a single-card or single-poster "conjured" reveal.
elements.use: one hero card, poster or cover needs a magic-trick reveal on a dark stage; a single card per shot.

elements.title: Map to Globe Morph
elements.desc: A flat dotted world map folds into a dotted sphere: every dot lerps from its equirectangular position to its sphere position with a west-to-east stagger and a lift, while the camera pulls back. Use as a scene transition or reveal.
elements.use: "flat to global" reveals, section transitions into a globe scene.

elements.title: Map Outline Trace
elements.desc: Outline-only map: region borders trace on with the pathLength dash trick, faint graticule and contour rings, one region thickens and glows.
elements.use: minimalist/diagrammatic geography, border tracing, tech or editorial intros, "region X" emphasis.

elements.title: Marker Underline Title
elements.desc: A serif headline lands line by line, then a heavy marker underline is drawn left to right under one italic keyword; the stroke is a variable-width brush with a dry-brush edge and a slight upward slope that follows the italic.
elements.use: a headline where one keyword needs emphasis (new, free, AI); a hand-made or human brand tone; annotation-style emphasis in body titles.

elements.title: Marquee Ticker
elements.desc: Infinite seamless scrolling strip of text or logo nodes, deterministic by frame, either direction. Variants: atxt-14-multi-marquee.
elements.use: tickers, repeating keywords, logo walls, bands between sections.

elements.title: Masked Word Rise
elements.desc: Headline words slide up from behind their own mask, staggered; the default kinetic-title entrance
elements.use: hero headline / hook line, 3-10 words.

elements.title: Matrix Rain
elements.desc: Digital rain: columns of green glyphs falling at seeded speeds with a bright head and fading tail; glyph set and density are props.
elements.use: hacker/tech/AI/cyber beats, loading and "system" backgrounds.

elements.title: Mini Strip Fill
elements.desc: Vertical 4-slot photo strip (top-right): on each flash a flash frame shows and a placeholder photo flies from centre into its slot with a spring
elements.use: photo-booth reels, "collect the shots" progress, gallery fill-ins.

elements.title: Modal Toast Ui
elements.desc: Window springs up, confirm dialog springs in, cursor arcs to the button with an eased move, button press dip, toast drops from the top.
elements.use: Fake-UI beat ("click to unlock"), reveal via interaction, app-demo gags.

elements.title: Model Switcher
elements.desc: A long row of tiles; a selection frame hops through several with a short beat on each, then settles green with a check and an AUTO name pill. Use for automatic selection or routing.
elements.use: "it picks the right one for you", model/plan/tool switching, A/B choice.

elements.title: Montage Hook
elements.desc: Rapid montage cut every 8 frames (coloured placeholder tiles) under a dim overlay; huge title slams scale 1.6→1 via spring; label pill.
elements.use: Reel openers/hook, 'one clip, many looks' intros.

elements.title: Mosaic Censor
elements.desc: Pixel-mosaic a rectangular region (children via SVG filter, or sampled colour blocks) plus a big "?" sticker, for spoiler-free covers
elements.use: spoiler-free thumbnails/covers, hiding faces or reveals with a guess-me "?".

elements.title: Mosaic Reframe
elements.desc: Twelve tiles continuously re-flow between a regular grid, a feature mosaic and a diagonal polaroid cascade; position, size and rotation each interpolate per tile with slight stagger and holds between layouts.
elements.use: showing one set of content in several layouts (portfolio, template library, photo products).

elements.title: Nebula Orb 3D
elements.desc: Audio-reactive 3D orb: a sphere displaced by smooth noise with a fresnel rim glow; the displacement and spin follow a `levels` array (0..1 per frame) or a procedural idle breath.
elements.use: AI-assistant / voice / music reels, "listening" and "speaking" beats.

elements.title: Negative Space Highlight
elements.desc: Text set in the empty region of an image; words reveal in sequence and one highlighted word gets a marker, colour and scale pop. Supports transparent alpha overlay.
elements.use: a photo has clear empty space (sky, wall, field) and a short quote or statement needs one word to carry the drama (5 s, MP4 or alpha).

elements.title: Neon Frame Forerun
elements.desc: A neon outline races from the left-edge midpoint both ways round and collides on the right; only then does the page light up from black while its pieces drop from the air with soft shadows in staggered order; background neon echoes ignite then switch off.
elements.use: "a UI is being placed here" reveals, dashboards and app screens introduced in a stylised space.

elements.title: Neon Frame Orbit Drop
elements.desc: Twin of neon-frame-forerun - the same neon frame first, but the camera sweeps one continuous arc (yaw +38 to -26 degrees) while EVERY piece lifts, falls and lands on the same frames with its soft shadow converging in sync.
elements.use: one-page whole-screen debuts where the page should arrive as one body.

elements.title: Neon Triple Marquee
elements.desc: Three rows of hollow neon letters scroll in opposite directions on a tilted brick wall above a wet floor with a mirrored reflection; one row is lit at a time (a three-way chorus), then the rows power off one by one.
elements.use: closing theme-word recaps, three-word slogans, music sections without voice-over.

elements.title: Newsprint Background
elements.desc: Off-white newsprint background with seeded text-column bars, halftone dot field and slow vertical drift; paper-collage base layer.
elements.use: collage and editorial reels, under cards and headlines.

elements.title: Next Episode Teaser
elements.desc: Outro card: "NEXT" kicker, episode title, a progress ring counting down to the next drop and a follow prompt.
elements.use: series outros, "part 2 tomorrow" endings.

elements.title: Notification Card Stack
elements.desc: Toast/notification cards slide in with spring and older ones step down a shrinking staircase.
elements.use: app notifications, social proof, alerts stacking.

elements.title: Orbit Ring Title Open
elements.desc: Eight dark 16:9 content cards travel round a tilted ellipse at a constant pace, staying face-on and scaled, blurred and dimmed by depth, while two-line title text blurs into focus and a highlighter bar sweeps across the key word. The card contents stay frozen on their first frame until the ring has opened. Use as an opening "this product has a whole set of things" shot in place of a static grid.
elements.use: a library, template set, feature matrix or case-study wall needs a moving "there is a whole system" opener, with a headline held centre-frame.

elements.title: Orbit Ring
elements.desc: A hero tile pops dead centre and lifts; satellite tiles shoot out on drawn spokes and keep orbiting while a tick ring and a four-row dotted halo fill clockwise. Use for "connects to N things".
elements.use: one hub connecting many tools/models; ecosystem or integration hooks.

elements.title: Outline Word Fill
elements.desc: A hollow word shrinks 3.2x into place, a dashed ring and two dashed axis lines slowly aim at it, then the solid fill snaps on in a single frame with one flash and shock ring; the two mono read-outs above and below carry a before/after comparison.
elements.use: a single short word or claim used as a heavy beat (benefit, slogan, "nail" frame); a beat-synced accent on a dark brand frame; a before/after punch line.

elements.title: Outro Group Photo Launch
elements.desc: A brand-mark pre-press stamps in first, then nine elements from the film fly in from all sides with a rotating, motion-blurred overshoot and settle around the wordmark like a group photo, under a crane drop, a light band, stage light and gold dust.
elements.use: launch-event finale for multi-feature products; the "all of these belong to one product" shot.

elements.title: Outro Lockup
